question: What is the meaning of emission trading in relation to life cycle assessment (lca)?
description: Emission trading in relation to Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) refers to a market-based approach where companies can buy or sell emission allowances to stay within regulatory limits on their emissions. This system allows for the trading of emission credits, enabling companies to reduce their overall emissions by either reducing their own emissions or purchasing credits from others who have emitted less than their allocated limit.
